title: WaterColor "Pelicans by the Sea" 30 WaterColor Blvd North #301
h1: WaterColor "Pelicans by the Sea" 30 WaterColor Blvd North #301
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 4 amenity access bands.**- Located in the center of WaterColor with views of Town Center and Cerulean Park- Washer/Dryer- 2 adult bikes provided- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Enjoy fabulous views of Cerulean Park, plus the ultra-convenience of Town Center from this third-floor multi-family residence with accommodations for four. Dark wood and leather furnishings set against pale sage walls and gauzy window treatments create a dreamy West Indies oasis designed for comfort. The living room is furnished with a rich leather sofa and chair, plus additional upholstered chair, all with views of the entertainment TV. The adjacent dining table seats four, with an additional 2 seats at the breakfast bar. The kitchen has honey-toned cabinets with panel-front refrigerator and stainless appliances, all highlighted with dark countertops. The side room off the kitchen is furnished with a queen-sized bed and opens to the furnished screened balcony overlooking beautiful Cerulean Park. The bath features a walk-in shower and single vanity. The primary suite has balcony access, with views of Town Center and Cerulean Park, and contains a king bed, office desk, and smart tv. The private bath has a combination shower and jetted tub, plus dual vanity. Enjoy this super convenient condo located just above great shopping and delicious restaurants. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Jetted TubGuest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Bathroom With ShowerWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective January 11th 2024, Watercolor Community HOA will no longer allow Low-Speed Vehicles to be rented by guests staying in the Town Center Condos.
